newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Rescuers try to free six trapped in Lisbon tunnel.
newsitem.headline: Rescuers try to free six trapped in Lisbon tunnel.

text.p: Rescuers were trying to reach six workers trapped about 25 metres underground on Wednesday when a tunnel under construction as part of an extension to the Lisbon underground train system collapsed.

Officials representing the Lisbon underground system, said that the men, one of whom suffered a slight leg injury, were in no danger as they were in an underground chamber into which air was being pumped.
The tunnel collapsed after a landslide triggered by heavy recent rain. Firefighters were trying to cut a hole through a block of concrete to reach the men.
